verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs say structured extraction returns fields 'with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability', so the product itself provides per-field source provenance. That claim is a single homepage line, though, and it covers only bounding boxes. missing for 10: explicit per-field page number, source-text snippet in the output, API response schema docs showing the citation format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify

citations.quote: Extract specific fields with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability
Extract specific fields from documents by providing a JSON schema. Marker parses the document and fills in your schema with extracted values.
